key_symptoms: Runny nose; sneezing; mild cough; low-grade fever
red_flags: Fast or noisy breathing; fever above 39C over 3 days; poor feeding
first_line_guidance: Supportive care with fluids and rest; see a pediatrician if red flags appear

key_symptoms: Ear pain; ear tugging; fever; fussiness
red_flags: Ear discharge; severe pain; symptoms beyond 2-3 days
first_line_guidance: A pediatrician decides between observation and antibiotics; never start antibiotics on your own

key_symptoms: Wheeze; night cough; breathlessness with activity
red_flags: Blue lips; cannot speak full sentences; reliever needed very often
first_line_guidance: Diagnosis and written action plan come from a pediatrician; families follow the plan

key_symptoms: Vomiting; watery diarrhea; mild fever
red_flags: No urine 6+ hours; sunken eyes; very sleepy; blood in stool
first_line_guidance: ORS for fluid loss; urgent care if dehydration signs appear

key_symptoms: Rectal temperature 38C or higher
red_flags: ANY fever at this age is itself the red flag
first_line_guidance: Immediate medical care; do not wait or try home treatment

key_symptoms: Itchy blister rash; mild fever
red_flags: Blisters near eyes; breathing difficulty; infected-looking sores
first_line_guidance: Keep child home and comfortable; pediatrician advises on itch relief; vaccine prevents most cases

key_symptoms: Barky cough; hoarse voice; worse at night
red_flags: Stridor at rest; drooling; blue lips; severe distress
first_line_guidance: Calm the child; urgent care if any red flag appears

key_symptoms: Runny nose then wheeze and cough; poor feeding
red_flags: Fast breathing; ribs showing; pauses in breathing
first_line_guidance: Supportive care with fluids and monitoring; antibiotics do not treat viruses; hospital if labored breathing

key_symptoms: Infrequent hard stools; pain passing stool; withholding
red_flags: Blood in stool; vomiting; swollen belly; weight loss
first_line_guidance: Fluids fiber and activity first; pediatrician guides any laxative use; never dose laxatives yourself

key_symptoms: Dry itchy patches; worse in winter; allergy family history
red_flags: Oozing or crusted sores; spreading redness with fever; severe sleep loss
first_line_guidance: Moisturizers and trigger avoidance; pediatrician grades severity and prescribes treatment

key_symptoms: Fever; mouth sores; rash on hands and feet
red_flags: Dehydration from refusing fluids; very sleepy; stiff neck
first_line_guidance: Cold fluids and soft foods; fluids matter most; care if child stops drinking

key_symptoms: High fever 3-4 days then pink rash as fever breaks
red_flags: Seizure with fever; rash with breathing difficulty; fever beyond 4 days
first_line_guidance: Fever comfort per pediatric guidance; rash phase needs no treatment; urgent care for seizures

key_symptoms: Slapped-cheek rash; mild fever; cold-like start
red_flags: Severe anemia signs in blood disorders; joint swelling; rash in pregnancy contacts
first_line_guidance: Usually mild and self-limited; keep comfortable; pregnant contacts should call their doctor

key_symptoms: Sore throat; sandpaper rash; strawberry tongue; fever
red_flags: Trouble breathing or swallowing; drooling; rash with high persistent fever
first_line_guidance: Needs a pediatrician visit for testing and prescription antibiotics; finish the full course

key_symptoms: Sudden sore throat; fever; swollen neck glands; no cough
red_flags: Croup-like breathing trouble; drooling; rash; symptoms beyond 2 days
first_line_guidance: Test before antibiotics; viral sore throats need no antibiotics; see a pediatrician

key_symptoms: Ear pain worse when pulling the ear; itching; discharge
red_flags: Severe swelling closing the canal; fever with spreading redness; diabetes or immune issues
first_line_guidance: Ear drops per prescription; keep ears dry; pediatrician confirms the diagnosis

key_symptoms: Red watery or sticky eyes; crusting overnight
red_flags: Eye pain; light sensitivity; vision changes; newborn with sticky eyes
first_line_guidance: Most viral cases resolve alone; bacterial cases may need drops; newborn eye discharge needs prompt care

key_symptoms: Scaly yellowish patches on scalp; mild redness
red_flags: Spreading raw or oozing patches; failure to thrive; widespread rash
first_line_guidance: Gentle washing and soft brushing; harmless and usually fades; pediatrician if spreading

key_symptoms: Red irritated skin in diaper area; mild discomfort
red_flags: Blisters or open sores; spreading beyond diaper area; fever
first_line_guidance: Frequent changes and barrier ointment; air-dry skin; care if blistered or febrile

key_symptoms: Honey-colored crusts around nose and mouth; mild itch
red_flags: Spreading fast; large blisters; fever; not improving in 2-3 days
first_line_guidance: Prescription cream or antibiotics; keep sores covered; keep child home until treated per guidance

key_symptoms: Ring-shaped itchy scaly patches
red_flags: Widespread lesions; scalp involvement; oozing or painful patches
first_line_guidance: Antifungal cream per pharmacist guidance; scalp ringworm needs oral prescription; avoid sharing towels

key_symptoms: Itchy scalp; visible nits near ears and neck
red_flags: Secondary infected sores; rash beyond scalp; treatment failure twice
first_line_guidance: Medicated shampoo per package directions; wet-combing; wash bedding; school policy check

key_symptoms: Nighttime anal itching; irritability; trouble sleeping
red_flags: Weight loss; persistent daytime itching; vaginal irritation
first_line_guidance: Single-dose medicine per pharmacist guidance for household; handwashing and nail trimming; repeat per guidance

key_symptoms: Fever without clear cause; painful urination; foul urine; belly pain
red_flags: Vomiting with fever; back pain; newborn with fever; blood in urine
first_line_guidance: Needs testing before antibiotics; collect sample as instructed; infants with fever need prompt evaluation

key_symptoms: Fast breathing; cough; fever; chest indrawing
red_flags: Blue lips; grunting; inability to drink; severe chest indrawing
first_line_guidance: Urgent evaluation; antibiotics only for bacterial cases per prescription; vaccines prevent many cases

key_symptoms: Thirst; fewer wet diapers; dry mouth; sunken eyes
red_flags: No urine 6+ hours; lethargy; cold hands; rapid breathing
first_line_guidance: ORS early and often; continue feeding; emergency care for severe signs

key_symptoms: Seizure during rapid fever rise; brief generalized shaking
red_flags: Seizure over 5 minutes; repeated seizures in 24h; slow recovery; stiff neck
first_line_guidance: Time it and cushion the head; urgent care for first seizure or any red flag; most brief ones resolve

key_symptoms: Bump; brief cry; small cut or bruise
red_flags: Vomiting repeatedly; unusual sleepiness; unequal pupils; bleeding that won't stop; fall from height
first_line_guidance: Observe closely for 24 hours; wake once overnight per guidance; emergency for any red flag

key_symptoms: Bleeding from one nostril; often after nose picking or dry air
red_flags: Bleeding over 20 minutes; both nostrils heavy flow; frequent recurrences; after head injury
first_line_guidance: Pinch soft nose 10-15 minutes leaning forward; humidify air; care if prolonged or recurrent

key_symptoms: Evening leg aches; both legs; gone by morning; normal exams
red_flags: One-sided pain; joint swelling; limping; daytime pain; fever with pain
first_line_guidance: Reassurance plus gentle massage and warmth; red-flag patterns need evaluation

key_symptoms: Drooling; gum rubbing; fussiness; mild temperature
red_flags: High fever; diarrhea with dehydration; ear pulling with fever; rash
first_line_guidance: Chewing rings and gum massage; teething does not cause high fever; care for true fever signs

key_symptoms: Evening crying spells; clenched fists; draws knees up; consolable at times
red_flags: Blood in stool; vomiting; poor weight gain; fever
first_line_guidance: Soothing routines and burping; usually fades by 3-4 months; pediatrician rules out other causes

key_symptoms: Hives or swelling after food; vomiting; eczema flares
red_flags: Trouble breathing; throat tightness; dizziness; repeated vomiting (anaphylaxis signs)
first_line_guidance: Avoid the suspect food; emergency plan for severe reactions; allergist confirms with testing

key_symptoms: Sneezing; runny itchy nose; itchy eyes; seasonal pattern
red_flags: Wheezing with colds; chronic mouth breathing; poor sleep; recurrent ear infections
first_line_guidance: Saline rinses and trigger control; antihistamines per age labeling; pediatrician for persistent cases

key_symptoms: Local pain swelling and redness at sting site
red_flags: Trouble breathing; face or throat swelling; dizziness; widespread hives (anaphylaxis)
first_line_guidance: Cold compress and observation; emergency injection per action plan if prescribed; urgent care for systemic signs

key_symptoms: Red painful skin; small blisters; single small area
red_flags: Blistered large areas; face hands or joints involved; white or charred skin; breathing difficulty
first_line_guidance: Cool running water 10-20 minutes; cover loosely; urgent or emergency care by severity

key_symptoms: Small painful spot with visible splinter
red_flags: Deep or face-located splinter; spreading redness; pus; fever
first_line_guidance: Clean tweezers and clean skin; remove shallow ones; care for deep or infected cases

key_symptoms: Nausea in cars or boats; vomiting on trips; dizziness
red_flags: Dehydration from repeated vomiting; head injury context; severe headache with vomiting
first_line_guidance: Face-forward seating and fresh air; planned stops; pharmacist guidance for medicines by age

key_symptoms: Small red bumps in skin folds during heat; mild itch
red_flags: Pus-filled lesions; spreading with fever; oozing or crusted areas
first_line_guidance: Cool loose clothing and cool baths; fades in days; care for infected-looking lesions

key_symptoms: Red warm tender skin after sun; mild swelling
red_flags: Blistering burns; face swelling; fever or chills after burn; infant sunburn
first_line_guidance: Cool compresses and fluids; infants need shade not sun; urgent care for blistering or infant burns

key_symptoms: Pale numb fingers toes or ears in cold; tingling on rewarming
red_flags: White hard waxy skin; blisters; no feeling after rewarming
first_line_guidance: Warm gradually indoors; never rub snow on skin; urgent care for hard white areas or blisters

key_symptoms: Stalling at bedtime; night waking; early rising; daytime crankiness
red_flags: Loud nightly snoring with pauses; gasping; severe daytime sleepiness; failure to thrive
first_line_guidance: Consistent routine and sleep environment; screen limits before bed; pediatrician for breathing-related signs

key_symptoms: Wetting during sleep; otherwise healthy child; family history common
red_flags: Daytime wetting with pain; excessive thirst; snoring with pauses; sudden onset after dryness
first_line_guidance: Usually outgrown; limit evening fluids; moisture alarms per guidance; pediatrician for daytime symptoms

key_symptoms: Crying screaming or flailing when frustrated; brief episodes
red_flags: Hurting self or others; breath-holding with blue spells often; regression of skills
first_line_guidance: Stay calm and keep safe; name feelings after; pediatrician for injurious or regressive patterns

key_symptoms: Clinginess at goodbyes; crying at daycare drop-off; sleep protest
red_flags: Refusal to attend school with distress; physical complaints on school days; lasting beyond early years
first_line_guidance: Brief warm goodbyes and consistent routine; gradual exposure; professional help for school refusal

key_symptoms: Few words by 18 months; no two-word phrases by 2 years; poor response to name
red_flags: Hearing concerns; loss of words; no gestures by 12 months; no babbling by 9 months
first_line_guidance: Hearing check first; early intervention referral; pediatrician for any red flag

key_symptoms: Flattened spot on back or side of head; full neck movement
red_flags: Neck tilt with limited turning; facial asymmetry worsening; premature suture concern
first_line_guidance: Tummy time and position variation; pediatrician monitors; physiotherapy for neck tightness

key_symptoms: Soft bulge at belly button; bigger when crying; painless
red_flags: Hard painful non-reducible bulge; vomiting with bulge; red or discolored skin over it
first_line_guidance: Most close alone by age 3-5; never tape coins on it; urgent care for hard painful bulge

key_symptoms: One or both testicles not felt in scrotum at birth exams
red_flags: Empty scrotum persisting; groin lump with pain; signs of torsion (sudden groin pain and swelling)
first_line_guidance: Pediatrician tracks descent in early months; surgical referral per schedule; sudden groin pain is urgent

key_symptoms: Single vomit after cough or overeating; well between episodes
red_flags: Repeated vomiting; green vomit; blood; severe belly pain; head injury context; dehydration signs
first_line_guidance: Small sips and rest; watch for red flags; urgent care for green bloody or head-injury vomiting

key_symptoms: Small red streaks on hard stool surface; otherwise well child
red_flags: Large amounts; black tarry stools; belly pain with vomiting; poor growth; anal fissure with severe pain
first_line_guidance: Soften stools with fluids fiber and activity; pediatrician evaluates persistent cases; urgent for large bleeds

key_symptoms: Pea-sized tender neck nodes during colds; mobile and soft
red_flags: Hard fixed nodes; larger than 2cm; lasting over 4 weeks; night sweats with weight loss
first_line_guidance: Most shrink after infection passes; pediatrician evaluates persistent or hard nodes

key_symptoms: Rough skin bumps on hands or feet; mild tenderness on soles
red_flags: Spreading rapidly; painful sole warts limiting walking; facial warts; immune suppression
first_line_guidance: Many resolve alone; pharmacy treatments per directions; care for facial or function-limiting cases

key_symptoms: Small dome bumps with dimpled centers; clusters in folds
red_flags: Red painful infected bumps; spreading widely in eczema; eye-area bumps
first_line_guidance: Benign and self-limited over months; avoid scratching; care for infected or eye-area lesions

key_symptoms: Scaly patches with hair loss; itching; swollen neck glands
red_flags: Spreading despite treatment; painful boggy swelling; pus and fever
first_line_guidance: Needs oral prescription (creams alone fail on scalp); avoid sharing combs; complete the course

key_symptoms: Screaming confused episodes in early sleep; no memory after; returns to sleep
red_flags: Daytime sleepiness affecting function; episodes with stiffening or jerking; injury during episodes
first_line_guidance: Do not wake fully; keep safe; consistent sleep; pediatrician if atypical features appear

key_symptoms: Nightly noisy breathing; mouth breathing; restless sleep
red_flags: Observed pauses; gasping; daytime behavior issues; poor growth
first_line_guidance: Record a sleep video for the visit; pediatrician assesses airway and referrals; urgent for severe pauses

red_flags: See nosebleed entry
first_line_guidance: See nosebleed entry for first aid and red flags

key_symptoms: Paleness; tiredness; poor appetite; frequent infections
red_flags: Rapid heartbeat; breathlessness; pica with developmental delay; blood in stool
first_line_guidance: Iron-rich diet per guidance; testing decides supplements; never start iron doses yourself

key_symptoms: Low sunlight exposure; exclusive breastfeeding without supplementation; bone aches
red_flags: Rickets signs like bowed legs or beaded ribs; seizures with low calcium; fractures
first_line_guidance: Follow national supplementation schedule; diet plus safe sun; pediatrician tests and prescribes

key_symptoms: Tooth spots or holes; pain with sweets; bad breath
red_flags: Permanent tooth knocked out; facial swelling with fever; trauma with bleeding
first_line_guidance: Dentist visit for spots and pain; knocked permanent tooth kept moist and seen urgently; brush twice daily

key_symptoms: Thumb sucking for comfort; normal in toddlers
red_flags: Teeth shifting after age 4; skin infection of thumb; speech concerns
first_line_guidance: Praise reduction gently; dentist watches bite after age 4; pediatric dentist for persistent cases

key_symptoms: Lean build with normal energy and growth curve; big appetite
red_flags: Weight loss crossing curves; chronic diarrhea; fatigue with pallor; puberty delay
first_line_guidance: Track growth curve not single weigh-ins; diet review; pediatrician for curve-crossing loss

key_symptoms: Weight above curves with rapid gain; breathlessness in play; joint aches
red_flags: Snoring with pauses; dark neck patches with thirst; hip or knee pain with limp
first_line_guidance: Family activity and diet patterns; screen-time limits; pediatrician plans without shaming diets

key_symptoms: Tired burning eyes after screens; headaches; rubbing eyes
red_flags: Vision drop; crossed eyes; severe headache with vomiting; eye injury
first_line_guidance: 20-20-20 breaks and distance limits; outdoor time; eye exam for vision changes

key_symptoms: Not startling as newborn; TV very loud; school struggles; speech delay
red_flags: Discharge with fever; sudden hearing loss; after head injury; chronic ear fluid
first_line_guidance: Newborn screening then hearing tests per schedule; urgent care for sudden loss or injury

key_symptoms: Large local swelling after stings; anxiety about next sting
red_flags: Any past breathing difficulty or throat swelling after sting
first_line_guidance: Allergist for testing and action plan; emergency injection if prescribed; medical ID for severe cases

key_symptoms: Come-and-go belly pain; normal growth and exams; stress link
red_flags: Weight loss; waking pain at night; blood in stool; persistent vomiting; urinary burning
first_line_guidance: Symptom diary with foods and stress; pediatrician evaluates red flags; urgent for acute severe pain

key_symptoms: Tension-type episodes with stress or screens; normal neuro exams
red_flags: Sudden worst headache; vomiting with headache; vision changes; head injury context; fever with stiff neck
first_line_guidance: Regular sleep meals and breaks; diary of triggers; urgent care for red-flag headaches

key_symptoms: Brief lightheadedness standing fast; resolves sitting; dehydration context
red_flags: Fainting; chest pain with episodes; palpitations; injury from falls
first_line_guidance: Fluids and slow position changes; pediatrician for fainting or cardiac symptoms

key_symptoms: Arm held still after pull; crying then calm refusal to use arm
red_flags: Swelling or bruising; fall from height; deformity; numbness
first_line_guidance: Do not yank arms; clinician reduces it in seconds; urgent for swelling or trauma signs

key_symptoms: One-sided foul smelly discharge; visible bead; nose picking
red_flags: Button battery suspicion; bleeding that won't stop; breathing difficulty
first_line_guidance: Do not probe deeper; battery suspicion is emergency; clinician removes other objects

key_symptoms: Visible bead; mild pain; reduced hearing on one side
red_flags: Button battery or insect with severe pain; bleeding; dizziness with vomiting
first_line_guidance: Do not probe; oil only for insects per guidance; battery is emergency; clinician removes

key_symptoms: Witnessed swallow; drooling or refusing food; coughing
red_flags: Button battery swallow; breathing difficulty; drooling with pain; vomiting blood
first_line_guidance: Battery is immediate emergency; coins need same-day evaluation with imaging; never induce vomiting

key_symptoms: Small clean break from known vaccinated pet; mild pain
red_flags: Deep puncture; face or hand bites; unknown or stray animal; bleeding that won't stop; rabies risk
first_line_guidance: Clean with soap and water; verify vaccine status; urgent care and rabies protocol per exposure

key_symptoms: Attached tick found; small red spot after removal
red_flags: Expanding bullseye rash; fever with rash; tick in scalp unremovable; multiple ticks
first_line_guidance: Remove with fine tweezers close to skin; save the tick; pediatrician for rash or fever after bites

key_symptoms: Fever plus new rash; child alert and drinking
red_flags: Purple spots that don't fade; breathing difficulty; lethargy; stiff neck
first_line_guidance: Glass test for non-fading rash with urgent care if positive; pediatrician for other new rashes

key_symptoms: Fever 5+ days with red eyes lips rash and swollen hands
red_flags: Peeling skin with persistent fever; extreme irritability; enlarged neck node single large
first_line_guidance: Hospital evaluation for prolonged fever patterns; echocardiogram per protocol; never self-diagnose
